images.note: Cold open: 'Lyndon Johnson looks at the richest country on earth and declares war' on poverty. 1964 photographic portrait, contemporary. Master TIFF 1228x1536. No second institutional 1964 LBJ portrait found at the 1200px bar (LBJ Library portraits are later or event photos).
images.title: Lyndon B. Johnson, head-and-shoulders portrait, 1964

images.note: War on Poverty beat: Head Start, 'free preschool and meals for poor kids' - Johnson's 'break the cycle early' theory. Photo by Thomas J. O'Halloran, July 14, 1965, contemporary. Master TIFF 5326x3719.
images.title: Operation Head Start at Webb School, 1965

images.note: War on Poverty beat: Job Corps, 'free schooling and job training for young adults' under the Economic Opportunity Act of 1964. Photo dated 1965, contemporary. Master TIFF 5364x3670.
images.title: Job Corps camp at Catoctin, Maryland, 1965

images.note: Environment seed beat: Carson's 1962 Silent Spring 'had already brought pollution to the public's attention'; Michigan speech promised 'renew contact with nature.' Portrait shows Carson testifying before a Senate committee, 1963 - contemporary to the book's impact. Master TIFF 4096x3253. FWS/Google Arts & Culture copies could not be verified at bar; alt left null.
images.title: Rachel Carson, head-and-shoulders portrait testifying before Senate committee, 1963

images.note: Box 1 mandate beat: Johnson vs. Arizona Senator Barry Goldwater, 1964 - 'extremism in the defense of liberty is no vice,' ~60% popular vote, Democratic congressional majorities. Primary is a 1964 Goldwater head portrait (master TIFF 1208x1536). Alt is the 1964 Democratic National Convention hall in Atlantic City with 'LET US CONTINUE...' banner (2500x2500).
images.title: Barry Goldwater, head portrait, 1964

images.note: Verdict beat: MLK in 1967 - 'The promises of the Great Society have been shot down on the battlefields of Vietnam.' Primary is 1967 MLK portraits, contemporary to the Riverside Church speech (master TIFF 4096x3267). Alt shows LBJ with MLK Jr. in the Oval Office (1400x933).
images.title: Martin Luther King Jr., portraits, 1967

images.note: Box 1: Kennedy's New Frontier 'mostly stalled in Congress' - Johnson inherits and passes it as the fallen president's legacy. Primary shows VP Johnson visiting President Kennedy in the Oval Office, Sept 17, 1963 (2816x2218) - the handoff made visible. Alt is a 1961 color postcard portrait of JFK (master TIFF 3838x5626); honest note: it is a postcard-format portrait, contemporary.
images.title: Vice President Johnson visits President Kennedy, Oval Office, September 17, 1963

images.note: Box 3: Medicare (65+) and Medicaid (low-income), both 1965 - 'the most swapped pair in APUSH.' LBJ hands former President Truman a pen at the signing, Truman Library, Independence MO, July 30, 1965; Lady Bird Johnson, VP Humphrey, Bess Truman look on. 3000x2009. Alt null: Truman Library's own copy is 800px; every high-res copy traces to the same White House photo.
images.title: Johnson hands Truman a pen at the Medicare bill signing, July 30, 1965

images.note: Box 3: Immigration and Nationality Act (Hart-Celler), 1965 - killed the 1920s national-origins quotas; caps 170k Eastern / 120k Western Hemisphere. LBJ signs at Liberty Island with the Manhattan skyline behind, Oct 3, 1965. 2000x1344.
images.title: Johnson signs the Immigration and Nationality Act, Liberty Island, October 3, 1965

images.note: Box 1: LBJ names the vision at the University of Michigan commencement, Ann Arbor, May 22, 1964 - 'where the meaning of our lives matches the marvelous products of our labor.' LBJ in academic robes at Michigan Stadium, 4000x2657. RIGHTS NOTE: AADL marks this Ann Arbor News photo 'Copyright Protected.' Alt null: Bentley Historical Library (UM) IIIF blocks non-browser user agents.
images.source: Ann Arbor District Library (Ann Arbor News collection)
images.title: Lyndon B. Johnson at U-M commencement, Michigan Stadium, May 22, 1964

images.note: Box 4 verdict: 'the money ran out: Vietnam. The fiscal strain of the war forced Congress to cut back or kill some of the programs.' LBJ with US troops at Cam Ranh Bay, South Vietnam, December 1967 - contemporary to MLK's quote and the funding cuts. 3000x2003.
images.title: President Johnson visits troops, Cam Ranh Bay, South Vietnam, December 1967

images.note: Box 2: 'a new Department of Housing and Urban Development, billions for affordable housing' (1965). LBJ at the signing, Rose Garden, White House, 1965; White House photo by Yoichi Okamoto. 3500x2350. Per H.Res. 1250 the HUD Act was signed August 10, 1965.
images.title: Johnson at the signing of the Housing and Urban Development Act, 1965
